chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel and Hisham, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

Regarding what the people have narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: 'The people of two religions do not inherit each other,' he (peace be upon him) said: 'We inherit them and they do not inherit us, because Islam did not increase in his favor except for harshness.'
ai.seo_question: Why do Muslims inherit from People of the Book but they do not inherit from Muslims according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) refines the general prophetic maxim that 'people of two religions do not inherit from each other' by establishing an asymmetrical rule: Muslims inherit from the People of the Book, but not vice versa. He grounds this distinction in the principle that for the People of the Book, the attribute of 'Islam' (being under Islamic rule) does not grant them an increased share in inheritance, but rather imposes a form of legal 'harshness' or exclusion, reflecting the superior status of Islam in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel and Hisham,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said regarding what the people are reporting from the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> having said: ‘The people of the two Religions do not inherit (each other)’, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘We inherit them and they do not inherit us, because Al-Islam did not increase in his favour except for the harshness’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil from Hisham who has narrated the following:

“This is about what is narrated from the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause. He (the Messenger of Allah) has said that people of two religions do not inherit from each other. Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘We inherit from them but they cannot inherit from us because al-Islam has not increased anything in his favor except sternness.’”
